player_prompt.intro:
Udlala umdlalo we-Minesweeper.
Injongo yoludlalo ukuvusa zonke izikhotha ezingenawo imayini.
Ukwenza ukunyakaza, qamba uqobo nozalo wezikhundla ozifunayo ukuvusa usebenzisa ifomethi:
- `[row col]`: Vusa isikhotha esikhundleni esibekelwe.
Ngokwesibonelo:
- `[3 2]` ukuvusa isikhotha seSafu 3, Isilalo 2.
- `[5 6]` ukuvusa isikhotha seSafu 5, Isilalo 6.
Ekunyakazeni kwakho kokuqala, uzovusa indawo ezungezile isikhotha osikhethile ukuqinisekisa ekuseni elikhuselekile.
Isakhiwo sesibhodi samanje sikhonjwe ngezansi. Izikhotha ezingakavuswa ziboniswa nganeno ('.'), nambari eziqoshiwe zibonisa inani la mayini angakhona.
Qaphela ukungakhethi izikhotha eziqoshiwe.
Nansi isakhiwo sesibhodi samanje:

invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Izikhala ezichaziwe zomugqa nekholomu ziphume emingceleni.

outcome.turn_limit: Umkhawulo wokuphenduka ufinyelelwe. Uphumelele ukuveza {percent}% wamangqamuzana aphephile.
